messages:
Alex (CSM): Quick note: eng confirmed an ingestion routing hiccup from 07:05-07:28 PT that slowed several onboarding imports. Affected: 5 accounts (mix of trial + paid). Need status note + credits + reschedule options.
Rae (CS Ops): Please list accounts. I'll draft two short templates.
Jon (Eng): Root cause: rollout-config misrouted ~30% of ingest traffic to a legacy worker pool that hit a prefix-handling bug. Rolled back at 07:28 PT; requeues started at 07:32 and are finishing. No data exposure.
Onboard Bot: Incident INC-2026-301 logged: routing-hiccup-onboard. Severity: P3.
Alex (CSM): Affected: NomadRetail, BriefCaseAI, PaperTrailX, HarborDocs, EchoForms. Prioritize NomadRetail and BriefCaseAI.
Rae (CS Ops): Draft status (short):
Rae (CS Ops): "Hi <CustomerTeam>, we experienced a short interruption of the embeddings ingestion pipeline between 07:05-07:28 PT today that delayed some onboarding imports. We rolled back the change and requeued affected jobs; most work is complete and remaining items should finish within 90 minutes. No customer data was exposed. Your CSM will reach out with any scheduling changes and an RCA follow-up. 

- Redwood CS"
Priya (Billing): Provisional credit guidance: for paid POCs approve up to $1,200 pending CSM notes.
Jon (Eng): Postmortem draft in 48h. Fixes: gate rollout, add canary for ingest routing, extra requeue alerting.
Alex (CSM): I'll call NomadRetail and BriefCaseAI now; Rae send status to all five and include ticket refs.
Rae (CS Ops): Sent status messages to all impacted accounts with ticket refs. Pinging for reactions. :email:
Onboard Bot: Requeue validation: 5/5 jobs completed at 08:05 PT. Incident status: mitigated.
Alex (CSM): Thanks team. Capture any customer feedback about upload errors and add "post-incident check" to onboarding tickets. I'll follow up after the postmortem is published.
